actions.add_annotation.description: Add an annotation to a Matomo site
actions.add_annotation.props.date.descri: The date to add the note to. Format: YYYY-MM-DD
actions.add_annotation.props.starred.des: Whether or not the note should be starred
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
auth.description:
Authenticate with Matomo.

Your Matomo domain is the URL of your Matomo account, e.g. https://matomo.example.com

Your Token Auth key can be found in your Matomo account under Settings > API.

Your Site ID can be found in your Matomo account under Administration > Websites.
auth.props.domain.description: The domain of your Matomo account: https://matomo.example.com
auth.props.siteId.description: The site ID that will be associated to this connection. Site IDs can be found on the main Websites page.
auth.props.tokenAuth.description: The Token Auth key from your Matomo account
